justification: Panel A depicts schematic boats with upturned prows and rows of small standing figures aboard, rendered in a flat linear outline style; panel B depicts a single richly attired human figure in low relief with naturalistic proportions, headdress, jewelry, and accompanying glyphic text blocks. There is no correspondence in subject matter (vessels and crews vs. a single adorned figure with script) nor in composition, so no meaningful shared iconography exists between them.
